I've been a client of the clinic since 2019 (my husband is also a long-time client), and I've always received excellent service, from the reception to the dentists. The clinic is clean, well-organized, the staff is polite, and the price is very fair, in addition to the easy payment options. It's also well located, in the center of Cotia, near Drogasil and Sumirê.

Negative points: the stairs, which are impractical for people with mobility issues (I don't know if there's another way to access the clinic other than by stairs), and the bathroom doors, which I find quite inconvenient because they're made of frosted glass, but when someone is inside, those outside can see the shadow and get an idea of ​​what the person is doing, haha. I've already recommended it to friends and family.
